subject: Linux ONNX Runtime A/B configuration SIGSEGV
ruledOut: Docker OOMKill: both failed containers reported OOMKilled=false and exit 1.
Corrupt Abseil/ONNX archive: isolated CMake download and extract probes succeeded, and the retry completed ONNX extract before crashing.
ONNX source-tree defect: the crashing commands were cmake -E echo_append and cmake -E touch after a successful extract and patch.

observed.initialFailure: FetchContent abseil_cpp-populate download/verify/extract chain SIGSEGV after Downloading... done.
observed.retryFailure: FetchContent onnx-populate no-test stamp: cmake -E echo_append && cmake -E touch .../onnx-populate-test SIGSEGV.
observed.cpuinfoLeak: uname -m is x86_64 inside the amd64 container while /proc/cpuinfo reports ARM Features (fp asimd aes ...).

sdkCmake.file: ELF 64-bit LSB executable, x86-64, version 1 (GNU/Linux), dynamically linked, interpreter /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2, for GNU/Linux 3.2.0, stripped

sdkNinja.file: ELF 64-bit LSB executable, x86-64, version 1 (GNU/Linux), dynamically linked, interpreter /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2, for GNU/Linux 3.2.0, stripped

reproduction: Isolated cmake --version, cmake -E echo_append, and cmake -E touch succeeded, including 20 sequential echo_append invocations from Python.

The exact ninja CUSTOM_COMMAND `cd $build && cmake -E echo_append && cmake -E touch $build/loop.stamp` SIGSEGV'd once on a virtiofs bind mount with Android SDK ninja 1.12.1. That is the same command shape as the ONNX populate no-test stamp.

The same two-command ninja rule later succeeded on tmpfs and bind mounts with both Android SDK ninja and Debian ninja 1.11.1, so the crash is intermittent rather than a deterministic archive or CMakeLists defect.
ExternalProject steps that invoke a single cmake -E command completed in the same diagnostic container that later crashed on the concatenated echo_append && touch rule.

conclusion: The configuration failure is an intermittent SIGSEGV of Android SDK CMake 3.31.6 when qemu-user 7.0.0 runs its non-PIE linux-x86_64 binary as ninja-spawned FetchContent helper commands. It is not established as OOM, a corrupt dependency archive, or an ONNX source defect.

fix.hostCmake: Debian bookworm-backports cmake 3.31.6-2~bpo12+1 on PATH as /usr/bin/cmake (PIE, distro-linked).
fix.sdkCmake: Keep Android SDK cmake;3.31.6 installed for AGP package discovery. Do not prepend its bin directory to PATH.

limitations: qemu-user 7.0.0 remains the amd64 execution path on this aarch64 Colima VM; Debian CMake is a host-tool substitution, not a qemu upgrade.
Diagnosis does not prove a successful native AAR pair. Independent A/B compilation remains required.
A development operator inventory AAR is not a model-qualified release runtime.
